##### Project general facts

Red Square by Tiger Group is a contemporary residential development located in the vibrant community, introducing a collection of studio, one, and two-bedroom apartments. Standing as a testament to Tiger Group's commitment to delivering quality residences in one of Dubai's sought-after neighborhoods, Red Square seamlessly combines style and functionality, offering residents a comfortable and well-appointed space to call home. These towers represent elegance, providing an unmatched level of comfort and sophistication in everyday lifestyle.

Red Square offers a living experience that goes above and beyond the typical, with first-rate features and premium materials that beautifully capture the beauty of the surroundings. Residents enjoy a magical work of art in the center of Dubai, where sophistication and elegance meet timeless craftsmanship and creative design in every apartment.

Every residence at Red Square is a testament to timeless craftsmanship and creative design, featuring exquisite interiors that exude sophistication and elegance. Apartments are fully furnished with equipped kitchens, creating a living area that is both functional and beautifully appointed. The interior design reflects the charm and magic of a living space that turns treasured moments into unforgettable experiences.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Triangle, a well-planned and family-friendly residential community in the heart of Dubai, this exceptional location is characterized by its unique triangular shape and thoughtful design, creating a tranquil and vibrant environment for residents. The community is adorned with parks, jogging and cycling tracks, and serene walking paths, offering a peaceful retreat from the bustling city.

The location is distinguished by its extensive landscaping, lush green spaces, and strong emphasis on community living. A range of retail outlets, supermarkets, and dining options ensure residents have easy access to daily necessities, while its own international school makes it a convenient choice for families with school-age children. The central location offers convenient access to major highways, making it easy to reach key areas of Dubai, including bustling business districts, popular entertainment hubs, and the city's pristine beaches.

For those seeking a residence that embodies contemporary elegance, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Triangle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of green spaces, family-friendly amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — tranquil, connected and effortlessly refined.
